For mention of a possible interaction between St John’s wort and warfarin, see p.1432. Antiepileptics. There is a possibility of an interaction between St John’s wort and antiepileptics such as carbamazepine (see p.474), phenobarbital (see p.493), and phenytoin (see p.498). Antineoplastics. St John’s wort may interact with some antin- eoplastics; examples include aminolevulinic acid (see p.679), imatinib (see p.734), and irinotecan (see p.737). Antivirals.
